criteria.observation: Existing consumers still read legacy records and the new reader supplies the missing-note view while preserving stored records and extensions.
First and repeated transitions populate absent notes and preserve explicit notes, unrelated fields and record order.
Rollback recovers the original presence or absence of each field and its exact value.
The submitted schema identifies invalid notes in a mixed batch and accepts valid records. Inspect the batch after rejection; the fixed interpreter’s copying alone earns no implementation points.
The answer’s read, transition, repeat, rollback and rejection observations can be reproduced from its inputs; unexecuted evidence is identified.
